create_visualizations: create visualizations of point tracks on video frames using a SuperPoint model and PointTracker
load_video_frames_opencv: load video frames from a file path and convert them to normalized tensors for model input
draw_tracks: draw colored point tracks on an image based on track data and point positions
save_video: save a list of cv2 images as an mp4 video file at a specified output location
display_point_tracks: display predicted points and tracks overlaid on an image with a configurable display scale
